front_matter.text: S'imootoosa geetettiyaa, ammaniyaa yalagay, K'eeri Iisiyaa geetettiyaa sa'aan yeletteedda. I bare daay baggana Ayihude asaa; bare aabbu baggana k'ay Giriike asaa. I P'awuloosanna kiitaan ittippe zuppetiyaa asaa; mishiraachchuwaa k'aalaa kiitaakka aanana maadettiide ootsiyaawaa. P'awuloosi S'imootoosaw s'aafeedda koyro kiitay heezzu ayfe yewatuwaan shaakettee.

Ubbaappe kasetiide ha kiitay ammaniyaa asaa giddon denddeedda worddo timirttiyaabaa minisiide odee. Ha imatsaa gideedda timirttii Ayihuda asatuwaa k'ofaappe baggaanne hara asatuwaa k'ofaappe bagga oyk'k'eeddawaa; «Hawe beettiyaa alamii nagaraan hambbalaachetti diggeeddawaa gidiyaa diraw, Asay atotetsaa demmanaw dumma gideedda S'uura eratetsaa eranaw, itti itti k'umatuwaa meennaan agganawunne machchiyaa akkenaaninne asinaa gelennaan de'anaw koshshee» yaagiyaa k'ofaa baaso ootsiide oyk'k'eeddawaa. Hewaa bollaakka gujjiide Aa kiitay ammaniyaa asaa ayissuwaabaanne goynnuwaa wogaabaa tamaarissiyaa timirttiyaa; hewaadankka k'ay ammaniyaa asaa kaaletsiyaawanttunne unttuntta maaddiyaawanttu ay mala eeshshaanna de'iyaawantta gidanaw bessintto odiyaabaa oyk'k'eedda. Wurssetsaan S'imootoosi Yesuusi Kiristtoosaw ootsiyaa lo"o oosanchchaa waaniide gidanaw danddayinttonne k'ay dumma dumma ammaniyaa asaa maabaraa sintsan aw de'iyaa aawotetsaw, P'awuloosi Aa zoreedda zoriyaa be'eetto.
Ammaniyaa asaabaanne unttunttu giddon ootsiyaa S'oossaa oosanchchatuwaabaa 1:3—3:16

verses.text: Nuuna ashshiyaa S'oossaynne nuuni be'ana giide nashechchan naagiyaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosi azazeedda azazuwaadan, Yesuusi Kiristtoosi kiitteeddawaa gideedda taani P'awuloosi,
ammanuwaa baggana ta tumu na'aw, S'imootoosaw ha dabddaabbiyaa s'aafay.

continuations.text: S'oossaa nu Aawuwaappenne nu Godaa Kiristtoosa Yesuusappe aad'd'o keekatetsay, maarotetsaynne sarotetsay new gido.

verses.text: Taani Mak'idooniyaa baade new geeddawaadan, neeni Efesoonen gam"ana mala koyaad. Itti itti asatuu wordduwaa timirttiyaa tamaarissiino; hewanttu tamaarissenna mala, aggite gaade oda.
Unttunttu tossaa odiyaawaanne barenttu zariyaa gayriyaawaa agganaadan oda. Ayaw gooppe, hewaa malabay palumaa kaaletsee; k'ay S'oossaa k'ofaa ammanuwaan erettiyaawaa ootsikkino.
Ha azazoo waanna k'ofay geeshsha wozanaappe, lo"o suure wozanaappe, Asay be'o giyaabay baynna ammanuwaappe beettiyaa siik'uwaa dentsetsanaassa.
Itti itti asatuu hawaa aggiide, maaddenna haasayaakko simmeeddino.
Unttunttu ayaa haasayinttonne woy barenttun ammanettiide odiyaabay ayentto erikkino; shin S'oossaa higgiyaa tamaarissiyaawantta gidanaw koyyiino.
Asay bessiyaawaadan higgiyan go"ettooppe, higgii lo"a gidiyaawaa nuuni ereetto.

Ittibaa akeekanaw koshshee. Higgii lo"o asaw med'ettibeenna. Shin higgiyaa mentsiyaawanttoo, azazettenawanttoo, makkalanchchatoo, nagaranchchatoo, geeshshatetsay baynnawanttoo, tunatoo, barenttu daayo woy aabba wod'iyaawanttoo, shemppuwaa wod'iyaawanttoo,

woshummanaw kajjeeliyaawanttoo, attuma Asay attuma asaana woshummiyaawanttoo, asaa zal"iyaawanttoo, worddanchchatoonne wordduwaan c'aak'k'iyaawanttoo, woy tumu timirttiyaanna gakettenna ay oosuwaa gidinakka ootsiyaawanttoo keseedda.
He tumo timirttii anjjetteedda S'oossay taani awaayana mala, taw hadaraa immeedda bonchcho wonggalaa gidduwaan de'ee.
Taani ootsiyaa kiitaan taw wolk'k'aa immeedda nu Godaa Kiristtoosa Yesuusa galatay. Taana bare oosanchchaa suntsiide, taana he oosoo bessiyaa ammanettowaa giide paydeedda dirawukka Aa galatay.
Taani hawaappe kase Aa boriyaawaa, Aa yederssiyaawaanne tuggayiyaawaa gidooppenne, taw hawaa I ootseedda. Shin taani erennaan ootseedda dirawunne ammanabeenna diraw, S'oossay taana maareedda.
K'ay nu Goday zaway baynna bare aad'd'o keekatetsaa ta bollan gussiide, Kiristtoosa Yesuusa baggana nubaa gideedda ammanuwaanne siik'uwaa taw immeedda.
Kiristtoosa Yesuusi nagaranchchatuwaa ashshanaw ha sa'aa yeedda giyaa haasayay ammanetteedawaanne Asay ubbay tuma giide akkanaw bessiyaawaa. Ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa nagaranchchay taana.
Shin med'inaa de'uwaa akkanaw Aan ammananaw bessiyaa asaw taani leemisuwaa gidanaadan, ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa nagaranchchaw taw Yesuusi Kiristtoosa daro danddayaadan, S'oossay taana maareedda.
Ayfiyaan beettena med'inaa S'oossaw Ittoo, med'inaa Kaatew, med'inaappe med'inaa gakkanaw galataynne bonchchuu gido. Amen"i!
Ta na'aa S'imootoosaa, kase nebaa timbbitiyaa odeeddawaadan, he odeeddawaadan lo"o olaa neeni olettana mala, ha azazuwaa new hadaraa immay.
Ammanuunne lo"o suure wozanay new de'o. Ittuu ittuu barenttu suure wozanaa yeggi aggiide, laaggiyaawe baynna markkabii bayiyaawaadan, barenttu ammanuwaa bayizzeeddinno.
S'oossaa boriyaawaa aggana mala, hewaa tamaaranaw taani Sees'aanaw aatsa immeedda Hemeneyoosinne Iskkinddiri unttunttu giddon de'iino.

Nuuni S'oossaa malatiyaawaan, geeshshatetsaa ubbaan, sarotetsaaninne ashikketetsan de'ana mala, asaa ubbaw, kaatetoonne suntsatetsay de'iyaa ubbatoo, S'oossaa oochchanaw, woossanaw, gaannatanawunne galatanaw bessiyaawaa ubbabaappe kasetaade taani neena erissay.
Asay ubbay attanaadaaninne tumatetsaa eranaadan koyyiyaa nuuna ashshiyaa S'oossaa sintsan hawe lo"iyaabaanne nashechchiyaawaa.
Ayaw gooppe, itti S'oossay de'ee; S'oossaappenne asaappe gidduwaan gidiide gaannatiyaa ittuu de'ee. Hewekka Kiristtoosi Yesuusa giyaa asaa.
I asaa ubbaa wozanaw barena ubbaw immeedda. S'oossay bare wodiyaan asaa ubbaa wozanaw koyiyaawaa bessiyaa markkay hawaa.
Taani S'oossaa k'aalaa odiyaawaa, Yesuusi kiitteeddawaanne k'ay ammanuwaaninne tumatetsaan Ayihuda gidenna asaa tamaarissiyaawaa gidaade suntseteeddawe hawaassa. Taani worddotikke; tumuwaa haasayay.
Hewaa diraw, ubba saan de'iyaa attuma Asay hank'k'uunne palumii baynnaan, bare geeshsha kushiyaa pude dentsiide, S'oossaa woossanaadan, taani koyyay.

Hewaadan k'ay mac'c'awanttukka bessiyaa mayuwaa yashshatetsaaninne barentta mooddiyaawaan mayyino. S'oossaw yayyay giyaa mac'c'a asaa bessiyaawaadan, lo"obaa ootsiyaawaanappe attin, huup'iyaa shurubbaa daddiyaawaan, work'k'aan woy ink'k'uwaan, woy daro al"o afilaan barena alleek'k'issoppino.
Mac'c'awunna ubbabaan moodettaadde, c'o"u gaade tamaaru.
Taani mac'c'awunna c'o"u gaade de'uu gayippe attin, attuma asaa tamaarissunne woy unttunttu bolla aawotuu giikke.
Ayaw gooppe, Addaami koyro med'etteedda; Hewaana guyyeppe med'ettaaddu.
Hewaana c'imettaade S'oossaa higgiyaa mentsaadduppe attin, Addaami c'imettibeenna.
Shin mac'c'awunna ammanuwaan, siik'uwaan, geeshshatetsaaninne barena mooddaade de'ooppe, naanaa yeliyaawaan attana.

notes.text: + Naanaa yeliyaawaan attana: Naanaa yeliyaawaan naagetta de'ana guussaa.

verses.text: Ooninne woosa golliyaa kaaletsiyaawaa gidanaw koyyooppe, lo"obaa amotteedda giyaa haasayay tuma.

Woosa golliyaa kaaletsiyaa uray borissennawaa, itti machchatti s'alalay de'iyaawaa, barena mooddiyaawaa, barena naagiyaawaa, barew bessiyaawaa ootsiyaawaa, imatsaa mokkiyaawaa, tamaarissanaw danddayiyaawaa,
matsottennawaa, ashikketetsaappe attin walak'ettennawaa, palumettennawaa, shaluwaa siik'ennawaa,
naanay aw azazettiyaawaanne bonchchiyaawaa, k'ay bare golliyaa ayissanaw danddayiyaawaa gidanaw bessee.
Ayaw gooppe, itti uray bare golliyaa ayissanaw danddayennawaa gidooppe, S'oossaa ammaniyaawantta wooti ayissanaw danddayii?
Otoruwaan sugettiid, s'alahiyaa kaappuu S'oossaa pirddan kunddeeddawaadan kunddenna mala, ooratsa ammaneedda asaa gidanaw bessena.
S'alahiyaa kaappuwaa boriyaaninne p'iriyaan gelenna mala, he uray woosa golliyaappe karenna de'iyaa asaan nashettiyaawaa gidanaw bessee.
Hewaadan k'ay woosa golliyaa maaddiyaawanttu Asay bonchchiyaawantta, laa"u doonaa haasayennawantta, daro woyniyaa eessaa ushennawantta, miishshaw yaaretennawantta,
ammanuwaa s'uuraa geeshsha wozanaa k'ofaan naagiyaawantta gidanaw bessee.
Hewanttu kasetiide paac'ettanaw koshshee. Paac'iyaa aad'd'owaappe guyyiyaan, woosa gollen ootsiyaawantta gidiide ootsino.
Hewaadankka k'ay unttunttu machchatuu Asay bonchchiyaawantta, zigirennawantta, barena mooddiyaawantta, ubbabaan ammanettiyaawantta gidanaw bessee.
Woosa golliyaa maaddiyaawe itti machchatti s'alalay de'iyaawaanne k'ay bare naanaanne bare golliyaa loytsi ayissiyaawaa gidanaw bessee.

Ayaw gooppe, woosa golliyaa maaddiyaawantta gidiide, lo"o oosuwaa ootsiyaawanttu barenttu huup'ew wolk'k'aama bonchchuwaa demmiino; k'ay Kiristtoosa Yesuusan barenttoo de'iyaa ammanuwaa loytsi s'aliide haasayanaw danddayiino.
Taani neekko ellekka baana gaade hawaa new s'aafay.
Shin taani beennaan gam"ooppe, S'oossaa gollen neeni woota de'anaw bessintto erana mala s'aafay. He gollii tumatetsaw tuussaanne baaso gidiyaa de'uwaa S'oossaa woosa golliyaa.
Nu ammanuwaa s'uuray wolk'k'aama gidiyaawaa ooninne sid'anaw danddayenna.

continuations.text: I s'illuwaa gidiyaawaa Geeshsha Ayyaanay markkatteedda.
Ayihuda gidenna Asay aabaa odina siseedda.

verses.text: Itti itti Asay wurssetsaa wodiyaan ammanuwaa agganawaa Geeshsha Ayyaanay k'onc'c'iyaan odeedda. Unttunttu worddo ayyaanatoo azazettana; k'ay s'alahatuwaa timirttiyaa kaallana.
Hawaa mala timirttii, tilla wozanaa tamaan bonk'k'eedda birataan guuddeeddawaadan donc'c'illeedda worddo asatuwaa baggana yeedda.

Hawanttu mala asatuu akkiyaawaanne geliyaawaa k'ay itti itti k'ommo katsaa miyaawaa diggiino. Shin ammaniyaawanttunne tumatetsaa eriyaawanttu S'oossaa galateeddawaappe guyyiyaan maana mala, S'oossay katsaa med'd'eedda.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay med'd'eeddabay ubbabaykka lo"a. S'oossaa galatiide akkooppe, olettiyaawe ayaynne baawa.
Ayaw gooppe, he ubbabay S'oossaa k'aalaaninne woosan anjjetteeddawaa.
Hewaa diraw, neeni ishatuwaa hewaa hassayissiyaawaa gidooppe, ammanuwaanne neeni kaalleedda lo"o timirttiyaa k'aalaan ek'ooppe neeni Kiristtoosi Yesuusaw lo"o oosanchcha gidanaassa.
Shin ammaniyaa asaw lo"enna haasayaappenne k'ay c'ima mac'c'a asaa tossaappe bak'ata. K'ay S'oossaa malatiyaawaan neena loohissa.
Ayaw gooppe, Asay bare bollaa minisiyaawe laafa go"ee. Shin S'oossaa malatiyaawaan loohissiyaawe ha"ikka sintsappekka de'uwaa immana giyaa diraw, ubbabawukka go"ee.
Ha haasayay Asay ubbay akkanaw bessiyaa tumu haasaya.
Nuuni hewaa demmanaw daabureettonne loytsi ootseetto; hewoo nuuni hidootaa wotseeddawe asaa ubbaa, ubbaappe aatsiide, ammaniyaawantta ashshiyaa de'uwaa S'oossaa.
Hawaa azazanne tamaarissa.
Neeni yalaga gidiyaa diraw, neena ooninne kad'oppo. Shin ammaniyaawanttoo ne haasayan, hanotetsan, siik'uwaan, ammanuwaaninne geeshshatetsaan leemisuwaa gida.
Taani yaana gakkanaw asaw S'oossaa mas'aafaa nabbabiyaawaani, S'oossaa k'aalaa odiyaawaaninne tamaarissiyaawaan minna.
Timbbitiyaa odiyaawanttu haasayinanne c'imatuu barenttu kushiyaa ne bolla wotsina, neeni akkeedda, neenan de'iyaa Geeshsha Ayaanaa imuwaa toochchoppa.
Ne dichchay asaa ubbaw k'onc'c'ana mala, hewaa minisa k'oppa. Hawaa ubbaa wode ootsa.
Ne huup'iyaanne ne timirttiyaa naaga. Neeni hewaa ootsooppe, neenanne neeni giyaawaa sisiyaawantta ashshiyaa diraw, aggenaan ootsa.
C'ima asaa ne aabba bonchchiyaawaadan bonchchappe attin, toochchoppa. Yalagatuwaa ne ishaadan,
k'ay c'ima mac'c'a asaa ne aattiidan, yalaga mac'c'a asaa ne michchatiidan, kumentsaa geeshshatetsaan bonchcha.
Bare s'alalaa gideedda tumu am"etuwaa bonchcha.

Shin am"attiw naanay woy naanaa naanay de'ooppe, he naanay S'oossaa malatiyaawaa barenttu soy asaa bessiyaawaaninne k'ay hewaa ootsiyaawaan barentta yeleeddawanttu kushiyaa zaariyaawaa tamaarino. Ayaw gooppe, hewe S'oossaa nashechchiyaawaa.
Ayaa maaduukka baynna bare de'iyaa tumu am"atta S'oossay immana gaade nashechchan naaga uttaaddu. K'ay gallassinne k'amma S'oossay izo maaddana mala, woossawunne oochchaw.
Shin barena ishalissiyaa am"atta pas'a de'ooppekka, iza hayk'k'adiggaaddu.
K'ay ooninne unttuntta borenna mala, ha azazuwaa imma.
Shin barenttuwoo k'ay ubbaappe aatsiide, bare soy asaw k'oppenna uray oonanne gidooppe, hewe bare ammanuwaa kaddeeddawaa. Ammanenna asaappekka aad'd'iide aw iita.
Usuppun tammu laytsay kumibeenna am"atti suntsaa maziggobiyaan s'aafoppa. Hewaa bollan k'ay iza itti asinaappe haraa gelabeennawunno gidanaw koshshee.

Naanaa dichchiyaawan, imatsaa mokkiyaawaan, geeshshatuwaa gediyaa meec'c'iyaawaan, waayetteedda asaa maaddiyaawaan, lo"o oosuwaa ubbaa kaalliyaawan, ha lo"o kiitaa kiitettiyaawaan eretteeddawunno gidanaw bessee.
Shin yalaga am"etuwaa yekkonttu suntsaanna gatsa s'aafoppa. Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barentta, asinaa gela gela giyaa wode, Kiristtoosa agganawantta.
Koyro ammanuwaa kad'eedda diraw, unttunttu pirddettana.
Hewe baynnaan oosuwaa d'ayiide itti golliyaappe hara golliyaa yuuyyiidde, hamettiyaawaa salalaa gidennaan, barenttoo bessenabaa haasayiidde, zigirssaanne yewuwaan c'oo geliyaawaa tamaariino.
Hewaa diraw, nu morkketuu nu bolla haasayiyaa iitabaa demmenna mala, yalaga am"atuu asinaa geliide, na'aa yeliide, barenttu golliyaa ayissana mala zoray.
Ayaw gooppe, hawaappe kase amareeda am"atuu Sees'aanaa kaallanaw aggiide guyye simmeeddino.
Ammaniyaa mishirattiw hak'ankka dabbo am"atuu de'ooppe, iza unttuntta maaddanaw bessee. Ammaniyaa asatuu maaduu bessiyaa tumu am"etuwaa maaddana mala, unttunttu ammaniyaawanttoo tooko gidoppino.
Loytsi heemmiyaa c'imatuu, k'ay ubbaappe aatsiide, k'aalaa odiyaawaaninne tamaarissiyaawaan daaburiyaawanttu, dakko bonchchuwaa akkanaw bessiino.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Uddumaan katsaa yed'd'iyaa booraa doonaa k'achchoppa» k'ay, «Oosanchchay bare dirgguwaa akkanaw bessee» yaagee.
Laa"u woy heezzu markkay baynnaan, woosa golliyaa c'imaa mootiyaawaa sisoppa.
Haratuu yayana mala, nagaraa ootsiyaa ubbatuwaa asaa ubbaa sintsan seera.
Neeni ayinne asaa deemuwaa s'eellennan, ittuwaa ittuwaappe dummayennan ha azazuwaa naagana mala, S'oossaaninne Yesuusi Kiristtoosan dooretteedda kiitanchchatuwaa sintsan neena taani zoray.
O bollaaninne elleellaade ne kushiyaa wotsoppa. Haratuwaa nagaraan geloppa. Neena geeshshatetsaan naaga.
Neeni ubbaa wode sakettiyaa dirawunne ne uluwaa diraw, guutsa woyniyaa eessaa ushappe attin, haatsaa s'alalaa ushoppa.
Itti itti asatuwaa nagaray be'anaw k'onc'c'e; unttunttu nagaray unttuntta pirddanaw unttunttuppe sintsaw aad'd'ee. Shin haratuu nagaray guyyeppe k'onc'c'ee.
Hewaadankka, lo"o oosuukka k'onc'c'ee. K'onc'c'ibeennabaa gidooppenne, geemmanaw danddayenna.
S'oossaa suntsaynne nu timirttii borettenna mala, ayiletetsaa morgge mitsaa giddon de'iyaawanttu barena mooddiyaa godatoo bonchchuu bessiyaawaa erino.

Ammaniyaa asaa ayiliyaa gideeddawanttoo unttunttu godatuu unttunttoo ishaa gidiyaa diraw, unttuntta kad'oppino. Shin barenttu kiitaan go"ettiyaawanttu unttunttu siik'iyaa ammaniyaawantta gidiyaa diraw, unttunttu kasewaappe aatsiide ootsanaw bessee.

continuations.text: Neeni ha yewatuwaa tamaarissanawunne odanaw bessee.

verses.text: Ooninne dumma timirttiyaa tamaarissiyaawaa gidooppe, k'ay nu Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa tumu k'aalaananne nu ammanuwaa timirttiyaanna gakettenna uray daro otorettee; ayinne erenna. K'ay k'aalaa bollan palumettanawunne walak'ettanaw unttunttoo giigenna k'ofay de'ee. Hewe k'anaatiyaa, palumaa, boriyaa, iita sid'iyaa kaaletsee.
K'ay unttunttu huup'ii ootsenna. Tumatetsay baynna asatuwaanakka palumaa kaaletsee. Unttunttu S'oossaa malatiyaawaan durettana giide k'oppiino. Neeni he asatuwaappe shaaketta.
Shin taw de'iyaabay taw gidana giyaa uraa S'oossaa malatiyaawe dureyee.
Ayaw gooppe, nuuni ha alamiyaa ayinne ahibeykko; k'ay aappe ayinne afokko.
Shin miyaabaynne mayiyaabay de'ooppe, hewe nuw gidanawaa.
Shin durettanaw koyyiyaawanttu paac'iyaaninne p'iriyaan geliino; k'ay daro asaa bashshawunne d'ayoo goochchi afiyaa daro eeyanne k'ohiyaa amuwaan kunddiino.
Ayaw gooppe, shaluwaa siik'iyaawe iitatetsaa ubbaw pulttuwaa. Ittuu ittuu hewaa amottiide, ammanuwaappe balettiide, daro metuwaan barentta k'oheeddino.
Shin neenoo, S'oossaa asaw, hewaappe bak'ata. S'illotetsaa, S'oossaa malatiyaawaa, ammanuwaa, siik'uwaa, danddayaanne ashikketetsaa kaala.
source_headings_before: P'awuloosi S'imootoosa Zoreedda // Zoriyaanne Azazeedda Azazuwaa

verses.text: Ammanuwaa baas'iyaa loytsa baas'eta. Daro asaa sintsan lo"o markkaa markkattaade, neena S'oossay s'eeseedda med'inaa de'uwaa oyk'k'a.

Ubbabaw de'uwaa immiyaa S'oossaa sintsaaninne, k'ay P'ens's'eenaawiyaa P'ilaas'oosa geetettiyaa gadiyaa mooddiyaawaa sintsan lo"o markkaa markkatteedda Kiristtoosi Yesuusa sintsan taani neena hawaa azazay.
Nu Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosi k'onc'c'ana gakkanaw, k'itay bayinnaaninne borii baynnaan he azazuwaa naaga.
Aa k'onc'c'etsaa, Itti suntsay de'iyaa anjjetteedda S'oossay, kaatatuwaa Kaatii, godatuwaa Goday, bare bessiyaa wodiyaan bessana.
Hayk'k'ennawe itti Aa s'alalaa. Ooninne Aakko shiik'anaw danddayenna poo'uwaan de'ee. Ooninne Aa be'ibeenna; k'ay be'anawukka danddayenna. Bonchchuunne med'inaa wolk'k'ay aw gido. Amen"i.

Ha"i ha wodiyaan dure gidiyaawanttu otorettennaadaaninne k'ay nuuni nashettanaadan, ubbabaa palahissiide Nuw immiyaa de'uwaa S'oossaan ammanettanawaappe attin, aad'd'iyaa duretetsaan unttunttu ammanettennaadan, unttuntta azaza.
Unttunttu lo"obaa ootsanaadan, lo"o kiitaan durettanaadan, keekiyaawanttanne haratuwaanna shaakki akkiyaawantta gidanaadan azaza.
Hewaa yaatiyaawaan unttunttu sintsaw barenttoo mino baaso gidiyaa shaluwaa barenttoo shiishshino. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, unttunttu tumu de'uwaa akkana.
S'imootoosaa, itti itti Asay balaan eratetsaa giyaa eeyaa palumiyaappenne mela haasayaappe bak'ataadde, new imetteedda hadaraa naaga.
Ayaw gooppe, ittuu ittuu nuw eratetsay de'ee yaagiidde, ammanuwaa baleeddino.

continuations.text: S'oossaa aad'd'o keekatetsay hinttenanna ubbaanna gido.
